name: ShuffleAttention
reference:
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

def _channel_shuffle(x, groups):
    b, c, h, w = x.shape
    x = x.reshape(b, groups, -1, h, w)
    x = x.permute(0, 2, 1, 3, 4)
    return x.reshape(b, -1, h, w)

def run(x, channel, reduction=16, G=8):
    torch.manual_seed(42)
    b, c, h, w = x.shape
    gn = nn.GroupNorm(channel // (2 * G), channel // (2 * G)).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    cweight = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, channel // (2 * G), 1, 1))
    cbias = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(1, channel // (2 * G), 1, 1))
    sweight = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, channel // (2 * G), 1, 1))
    sbias = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(1, channel // (2 * G), 1, 1))
    cweight = cweight.to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    cbias = cbias.to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    sweight = sweight.to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    sbias = sbias.to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)

    x = x.view(b * G, -1, h, w)
    x_0, x_1 = x.chunk(2, dim=1)
    avg_pool = F.adaptive_avg_pool2d(x_0, 1)
    x_channel = cweight * avg_pool + cbias
    x_channel = x_0 * torch.sigmoid(x_channel)
    x_spatial = gn(x_1)
    x_spatial = sweight * x_spatial + sbias
    x_spatial = x_1 * torch.sigmoid(x_spatial)
    out = torch.cat([x_channel, x_spatial], dim=1)
    out = out.contiguous().view(b, -1, h, w)
    out = _channel_shuffle(out, 2)
    return out
